title: Alternating Current AC Direct Current DC
definition: Alternating Current (AC) is an electric current that periodically reverses direction and changes magnitude continuously with time, whereas Direct Current (DC) flows in a single, constant direction with stable magnitude.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for GS Paper III (Science & Technology - Energy, Power Infrastructure, Smart Grids, Electric Vehicles, HVDC transmission networks, and Solar Photovoltaics).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Alternating Current AC Direct Current DC.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of electromagnetism, voltage, current, resistance, and Faraday's laws of induction.
